caption: The drawing depicts a textile object that appears to be a scarf or sash composed of two rectangular sections joined together at the top by a series of wrapped bands in a grayish hue. Each rectangular section is predominantly a deep reddish-purple color with intricate white patterns in a grid-like arrangement. The section on the left features a uniform pattern of white dots forming a square grid, while the section on the right has large red squares bordered by white dots, creating a checkerboard effect. Both ends of the textile are finished with a fringe made up of looped gray strands. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or embellishments.
title: Purse
